items.name: ChessLens
items.summary: A reproducible chess data and ML pipeline built around large-scale PGN processing, SQL analytics, and leakage-aware evaluation.
highlights: Built streaming Lichess PGN ingestion with deterministic game IDs, HMAC player identifiers, sharded Parquet, resumable manifests, checksums, and staged publication.
Recorded ingestion report: 10.64M accepted games, 718.56M moves, and 43 shards; this is a saved report, not a fresh run for this portfolio.
Created a DuckDB/dbt warehouse with 8 models and 39 data tests. The recorded 47 passing nodes were run against a deterministic 10% analysis sample, not the full move set.
Added temporal and player-holdout controls with leakage audits for policy and value baselines.
Implemented frequency, logistic-value, and LightGBM ranking baselines with ranking, calibration, subgroup, and game-level bootstrap evaluation.

items.name: Sustentra
items.summary: Schema-driven document intelligence and audit workflows for reviewing structured ESG evidence.
highlights: Contributed to a PDF/OCR pipeline that turns document content into schema-backed JSON with source snippets for reviewer traceability.
Translated ESG and audit requirements into versioned schemas, validation rules, and cross-service contracts with engineering and domain collaborators.
Helped build a seven-stage Streamlit auditor prototype for intake, extraction review, validation, and evidence workflows; some stages use prepared fixtures rather than connected live services.
Historical work records cite 40+ documents and a 170+ test suite; the prototype was presented to 10+ audit-industry and client representatives.

items.name: Recipe Discovery & Semantic Search
items.summary: Hybrid and multimodal recipe search with custom clustering and an interactive exploration interface.
highlights: Combined SBERT dense embeddings with TF-IDF retrieval, and added SigLIP image, text, and combined image-text search over the Food.com Recipes and Interactions dataset.
Implemented dietary and recipe filters, negative-feedback query adjustment, optional rating-aware reranking, and a session-based shopping list.
Built a PyTorch K-means implementation with k-means++ initialization, Lloyd updates, empty-cluster reseeding, and multiple restarts.
Added PCA and autoencoder-based embedding views for interactive cluster exploration.

items.name: Met Museum Cross-Modal Search
items.summary: Text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval over Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access data.
highlights: Combined image and text features with contrastive projection heads for cross-modal retrieval.
Built FAISS-backed text-to-image and image-to-text search.
Exposed the workflow through CLI, FastAPI, and Streamlit interfaces.

items.name: NYC Taxi Autoencoder Demo
items.summary: A PyTorch autoencoder demo for exploring a two-dimensional latent representation of taxi data.
highlights: Prepared numeric inputs for an autoencoder-based two-dimensional representation.
Exposed training and validation loss alongside an interactive Streamlit/Plotly view.

items.name: Chunithm Request Bot
items.summary: A Discord bot for managing Chunithm song requests during livestream sessions.
highlights: Added fuzzy song matching and owner-controlled request sessions.
Managed three-song request queues with SQLite persistence.
